description: This file defines the base class SugarFieldBase for managing field rendering, formatting, and handling logic within the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM framework. It provides methods for template fetching, field formatting/unformatting, rendering views (detail, edit, list, search), and handling save and import sanitization processes for fields in the CRM.

classes.name: SugarFieldBase
classes.description: A base class for different field types providing common rendering, formatting, and processing functionalities in the CRM framework.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Renders a template and appends additional HTML elements if specified.

methods.name: findTemplate
methods.description: Determines the appropriate Smarty template file path based on the field type, view, and current language.

methods.name: formatField
methods.description: Placeholder for formatting raw field data, meant to be overridden by subclasses.

methods.name: unformatField
methods.description: Placeholder for unformatting formatted field data, meant to be overridden by subclasses.

methods.name: getSmartyView
methods.description: Generates Smarty-rendered HTML for a specified view (DetailView, EditView, etc.).

methods.name: getListViewSmarty
methods.description: Generates Smarty-rendered HTML for list views.

methods.name: getDetailViewSmarty
methods.description: Generates Smarty-rendered HTML for detail views.

methods.name: getChangeLogSmarty
methods.description: Formats field data for change logs, defaulting to formatField.

methods.name: getEditViewSmarty
methods.description: Generates Smarty-rendered HTML for edit views, considering readonly conditions.

methods.name: getImportViewSmarty
methods.description: Generates Smarty-rendered HTML for import views, typically same as edit views.

methods.name: getSearchViewSmarty
methods.description: Generates Smarty-rendered HTML for search views.

methods.name: getPopupViewSmarty
methods.description: Generates Smarty-rendered HTML for popup views.

methods.name: getEmailTemplateValue
methods.description: Provides the field value suitable for email templates, defaulting to formatting logic.

methods.name: displayFromFunc
methods.description: Handles rendering of field data from a user-defined function, including support for HTML returns.

methods.name: getEditView
methods.description: Placeholder for subclasses to provide custom edit view logic.

methods.name: getSearchWhereValue
methods.description: Returns the value to be used in the search WHERE clause; default is identity.

methods.name: getSearchInput
methods.description: Retrieves the search input value from request arguments.

methods.name: getQueryLike
methods.description: Placeholder for generating SQL LIKE query snippets.

methods.name: getQueryIn
methods.description: Placeholder for generating SQL IN query snippets.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes Smarty template variables and accumulates additional HTML elements based on display parameters.

methods.name: getAccessKey
methods.description: Determines and returns access key labels for accessibility features based on given definitions.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a field value into a bean, applying trimming if applicable.

methods.name: isTrimmable
methods.description: Checks if a field type should be trimmed when saved.

methods.name: importSanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes import values for a field based on length restrictions.

methods.name: isRangeSearchView
methods.description: Determines if range search view should be displayed based on context.

methods.name: setupFieldArray
methods.description: Prepares and formats a parent field array or object, invoking formatField.
